inspiration: Herd wanderer: a leader-led group moves between five generated patrol points set 50.0 from home, waits 8 to 15 s on arrival, then rests (ai/herd.lua lines 18, 23, 36). Recreate as a leader-led drift between spawn-anchored points.

Body-drop ledger: each beast carries separate meat, hide and bone yields (bol.lua lines 16 and 18 show two). A kill reads as a small resource ledger. Recreate with per-family yields and our own resource names.
Hue-index skins: one model with a short list of hue indices gives many colour variants (bol.lua line 30). Recreate with our own palette ramps, one model per family.
Social flags as one bitmask: a pack flag and a herd flag share one field (bol.lua line 25). Recreate as flags on our creature template so a pack member pulls its neighbours into a fight.
Social key: creatures share a socialGroup string (ancient_graul.lua line 3). Recreate as a family key in zone data.
Nine-slot resistance vector per creature (bol.lua line 14). Slot order not read. Recreate as a short per-damage-type vector so weapon choice matters.
Look-first reflex: the raider tree is a selector whose first branch looks for a target (ai/villageRaider.lua lines 1 to 3). Recreate as an aggro reflex with a readable wind-up before the charge.

briefs.label: Grazing herd beast (own label)
briefs.why: A low, heavy, head-down silhouette reads calm, which suits a herd that drifts. Silhouette idea only; no art in this donor.
briefs.keep: PACK and HERD flags; one model with several hue skins; the group grazes as one cluster.
briefs.change: Armoured back plates instead of plain hide; longer neck; our own palette ramp; leader marked by a crest. Sound: none in donor, ours to design. Recreate as a distinct original, not a copy.

briefs.label: Patrolling herd leader (own label)
briefs.why: A group that wanders, then stops to rest, is a readable calm-before-fight beat.
briefs.keep: Dwell of 8 to 15 s on arrival at a patrol point, then move on.
briefs.change: The pause has a head-up scan animation; zone data sets the dwell numbers; our own patrol shape. Recreate as a distinct original, not a copy.

briefs.label: Reflex raider (own label)
briefs.why: A short look-first tree gives a clear first beat.
briefs.change: A visible wind-up before the charge and our own aggro radius. Recreate as a distinct original, not a copy.
